title: Alamaster Street job and the fire that destroyed his guitar and amplifier
summary: Nelson played a short time at Luton's on Alamaster Street with Blue, pianist Sammy and a drummer; a fire destroyed the drum and his guitar and amplifier, which he had to replace.
